title: Worse than Random: The Importance of a Baseline for Unsupervised Feature Selection -- Extended Version
abstract: arXiv:2605.22973v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many novel unsupervised feature selection methods are proposed each year, yet their empirical evaluation is limited to supervised and unsupervised evaluation metrics computed on selected datasets, along with comparisons to existing methods. However, in the absence of an established evaluation baseline, it is difficult to determine the value added to the existing literature by each of these methods, and how effective their underlying approaches are. In this evaluation study, we are using random feature selection as a baseline for evaluating unsupervised feature selection methods. While a random selection of features might seem to be a rather weak baseline, we show in this evaluation study that many of the state-of-the-art methods in unsupervised feature selection are outperformed by random feature selection in both performance and efficiency. translated_title: 比随机还差：无监督特征选择中基线的重要性——扩展版
translated_abstract: 每年都有许多新颖的无监督特征选择方法被提出，然而它们的实证评估仅限于在选定数据集上计算的有监督和无监督评估指标，以及与现有方法的比较。然而，在缺乏已建立的评估基线的情况下，很难确定这些方法为现有文献带来的额外价值，以及它们的基础方法究竟有多有效。在这项评估研究中，我们使用随机特征选择作为评估无监督特征选择方法的基线。虽然随机选择特征看起来似乎是一个相当弱的基线，但我们在这项评估研究中表明，许多最先进的无监督特征选择方法在性能和效率上都败给了随机特征选择。因此，我们强调在评估无监督特征选择方法时严格考虑随机特征选择基线的必要性。
tldr: 本文提出以随机特征选择作为基线来评估无监督特征选择方法，发现许多最先进的方法在性能和效率上竟然不如随机选择，强调了建立评估基线的重要性。
en_tdlr: This evaluation study uses random feature selection as a baseline for unsupervised feature selection methods, revealing that many state-of-the-art methods are outperformed by random selection in both performance and efficiency, emphasizing the critical importance of establishing such a baseline.
